title: [The Kraken's Dispatch, Deck]
description: Polished from stem to stern, the ship has pristine sails painted with the flotilla's signature ebon kraken floating in a crimson pool on a field of emerald green.  Large crates are stacked everywhere, each stamped with various ports of call and the phrase, "Mail for the Flotilla if you can find it."  A spacious staircase leads down, with a neatly lettered sign right next to it.
